claim_evidence_checks_conditions.conclusion: The spatial comparison covers all18 central runs using current living-effector denominators and the same saved-state definitions.
claim_evidence_checks_conditions.checks: All1746 hourly target/effector counts reconcile with accepted trajectory tables;1062 per-case metrics reconstructed;354 N3 summaries,531 paired differences and177 paired summaries independently checked.
claim_evidence_checks_conditions.conditions: Independent arithmetic review of hash-bound saved-state reports; no second raw geometric recomputation in this review.

claim_evidence_checks_conditions.conclusion: At6h, TE5 has a larger touching or saved-link fraction per living effector in allthree seeds of every scenario, despite fewer effectors overall.
claim_evidence_checks_conditions.checks: Numerators and current-living denominators recomputed for each seed; absolute counts retained beside fractions.
claim_evidence_checks_conditions.conditions: Snapshots are not contact frequencies, per-cell efficacy or causal mechanism fractions. Same seed does not guarantee common event histories; initial nested subsets do not remove later stochastic divergence.

claim_evidence_checks_conditions.conclusion: High fixed-hull membership does not imply frequent target overlap, particularly in the local-entry scenario at96h.
claim_evidence_checks_conditions.checks: Fixed initial hull and instantaneous living-target sphere overlap use separate quantities; negative seed1 difference retained.
claim_evidence_checks_conditions.conditions: Hull ignores target radii and remains fixed. It is not vascular infiltration; overlap is not antigen recognition. No uniform ratio ordering is claimed from the mean.

claim_evidence_checks_conditions.conclusion: The normalized saved-field direction diagnostic saturates at allselected6-96h timepoints in every central case despite very different gradient magnitudes.
claim_evidence_checks_conditions.checks: 90 selected case-time fractions and saved gradient medians reconstructed.
claim_evidence_checks_conditions.conditions: A normalized direction norm is not measured speed, biological sensing, or the historical cached motility vector. Saturation cannot calibrate bias or persistence.

claim_evidence_checks_conditions.conclusion: First saved positive memory and live-target link both occur at1h in allcentral runs; late links are mostly zero.
claim_evidence_checks_conditions.checks: First events independently located in97 hourly rows; all other17 cases have zero live-target link count at96h.
claim_evidence_checks_conditions.conditions: First saved time bounds an onset within the recording interval; it is not a measured activation delay. Zero saved links at an endpoint do not imply absent earlier interactions or a measured mechanism allocation.
